items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I saw him on television the other day

ctx.x: Then they opened a club there in 19 -- well, wait a minute, let me put everything in the respective order, because I'm bad on dates. Conga was playing here in the '30s. Then came (unintelligible) went to work with a show that was produced in Paris --
No, no. I saw him on television the other day, he had a show (unintelligible). Georgie Abbott.
